name: Substituted phenidates
summary: Substituted phenidates is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Substituted phenidates primarily act as reuptake inhibitors of the monoamine neurotransmitters dopamine, norepinephrine, and to a much lesser degree, serotonin.

uses.en: Methylphenidate is a prescription medicine for ADHD and narcolepsy. Other members, such as ethylphenidate, isopropylphenidate and 4F-MPH, have been sold as designer drugs.
uses.zh: 派醋甲酯是治療注意力不足過動症與猝睡症的處方藥。其他成員，例如乙酯苯哌啶（ethylphenidate）、isopropylphenidate與4F-MPH，則被當作設計師藥物販售。
uses.zhHans: 派醋甲酯是治疗注意力不足过动症与猝睡症的处方药。其他成员，例如乙酯苯哌啶（ethylphenidate）、isopropylphenidate与4F-MPH，则被当作设计师药物贩售。

sideEffects.en: They can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, poor sleep, loss of appetite and anxiety. Heavy use can lead to dependence and psychosis, and injecting them has caused serious infections and tissue damage.
sideEffects.zh: 它們可能造成心跳加速、血壓上升、失眠、食慾下降與焦慮。大量使用可能導致依賴與精神病，以注射方式使用則曾造成嚴重感染與組織損傷。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它们可能造成心跳加速、血压上升、失眠、食欲下降与焦虑。大量使用可能导致依赖与精神病，以注射方式使用则曾造成严重感染与组织损伤。

fact.en: Methylphenidate, the best-known member, was first made in 1944 by the Ciba chemist Leandro Panizzon. He named the brand Ritalin after his wife Marguerite, whose nickname was Rita.
fact.zh: 這個家族最知名的成員派醋甲酯，在1944年由汽巴藥廠的化學家萊安德羅．帕尼宗首次合成。他以妻子瑪格麗特的小名「Rita」為品牌命名，稱為利他能（Ritalin）。
fact.zhHans: 这个家族最知名的成员派醋甲酯，在1944年由汽巴药厂的化学家莱安德罗．帕尼宗首次合成。他以妻子玛格丽特的小名「Rita」为品牌命名，称为利他能（Ritalin）。
